title: Present perfect (intro) · 现在完成时入门
pattern: Subject + have / has + past participle (V3)  Subject + have / has + never / ever + V3
summary: have / has + 过去分词，表示过去的经历或对现在有影响的动作；ever、never、just、already、yet 是常用的搭配词。
explanation: **现在完成时**把过去和现在连接起来。它强调的是“到现在为止”的经历，或过去的动作对现在有影响，不强调具体发生在什么时候：I **have visited** Japan three times.（我去过日本三次。）这句话说的是经历，没有说具体哪一年去的。中文里“我去过”“我吃过”的意思，通常都用现在完成时来表达。
**构成**是 have / has + 过去分词（V3）。I、you、we、they 用 have，he、she、it 用 has：She **has finished**. 规则动词的 V3 与 -ed 过去式相同，不规则动词需要单独记：see → seen，eat → eaten，write → written，go → gone 或 been。
**经历**的常见搭配是 **ever**（疑问句，表示“曾经”）和 **never**（否定，表示“从来没有”）。它们放在 have 和过去分词之间：**Have** you **ever** been to London? / I have **never** tried durian. 这是很多学生容易忽略的语序。

**just、already、yet** 也常和现在完成时一起使用。just 表示“刚刚”，放在 have 和 V3 之间；already 表示“已经”，常用于肯定句；yet 表示“还（没）”，用于否定句和疑问句末尾：I have **just** finished my homework. / I haven't finished it **yet**. / Have you finished it **yet**?
**注意**：一旦句子中出现明确的过去时间（yesterday、last year、in 2019、three days ago），就要改用一般过去时：I **visited** Paris last year.，不能说 I have visited Paris last year. 现在完成时关注的是“经历”或“现在的结果”，而不是具体的过去时间点。
mistakes: ✗ I have see this movie. → ✓ I have seen this movie. have 后面要用过去分词 seen，不是动词原形 see。
✗ I have visited Paris last year. → ✓ I visited Paris last year. 有具体过去时间时要用一般过去时。
✗ She has went to Shanghai. → ✓ She has gone to Shanghai. went 是过去式，不能与 have 连用；go 的过去分词是 gone。
✗ I haven't finish my homework yet. → ✓ I haven't finished my homework yet. 否定形式 haven't 后面同样要用过去分词 finished。

examples.note: 表示经历，没有具体时间。

examples.text: Have you ever tried Peking duck?
examples.note: ever 放在 have 和 V3 之间。

examples.text: She has never flown in a plane.
examples.note: never 表示从未有过的经历。

examples.text: I have just finished my homework.
He has already left the office.
Have you finished the report yet?

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的过去分词形式。
exercises.explanation: 现在完成时用过去分词 seen。
表示经历用 has been to，went 不能与 has 连用。
否定句末尾用 yet 表示“还没有”。

exercises.translation: 他自2010年起就一直住在伦敦。
exercises.explanation: since 表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时 has lived。

options: I have ever eaten durian never.
exercises.explanation: 现在完成时用 have never + 过去分词 eaten。

options: He has arrived home just yet.
exercises.explanation: just 放在 has 和过去分词 arrived 之间，表示“刚刚”。
went 不能用于现在完成时，应写成 She has gone home.

options: I have visited Paris last summer.
exercises.explanation: last summer 是明确的过去时间，应写成 I visited Paris last summer.
